name: Monday dependency triage
prompt: Run the dependency-triage procedure on this repository: review outdated dependencies across every manifest and lockfile, apply patch/minor bumps only where the existing test suite proves them safe, and leave a triage note for any major bump instead of upgrading blind. Do not touch workflows, docs, or source to accommodate an upgrade — flag it instead. Finish with a table of package, current version, latest safe version, and what you did or recommend.
